name: Lost in Transit
summary: Dar asks you to find a missing goblin courier and his shipment bound for the Harborage. The loss threatens his trading reputation.

sections.title: A Missing Shipment
sections.body: Dar trades extra supplies with the draenei of the Harborage for part of their catch. Now his goblin courier has not returned with a shipment. Dar fears a crocolisk may have killed him, but recovering the goods matters to his business. You are asked to search near the waters along the road and get the shipment to the Harborage.

faq.answer: Dar trades extra supplies with the draenei of the Harborage for some of their catch.
Dar sent a goblin courier with his latest shipment, but the courier never returned.
The shipment was meant for the draenei at the Harborage.

faq.q: Why does Dar need the shipment found?
faq.answer: Dar says his business reputation is at stake if the shipment is not found and delivered.

faq.q: Where should I look for the courier?
faq.answer: Dar asks you to check near the waters along the road.

attribution: In-game quest text: Lost in Transit
